packageRules.description: Mail::DMARC >=1.20260612 performs a DNS tree walk in get_organizational_domain (RFC 9989), which recurses unboundedly with authentication_milter's Resolver: children OOM and no mail is authenticated. Keep below that until fastmail/authentication_milter#180 ships a fix.
Savannah serves spamass-milter as a plain directory index; keep only the .tar.gz entries (drops .sig, .bz2 and the sort links).
